== Biography ==
Henry was born in 1830. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] and [[Glendinning-340|Nancy Glendinning]]. 
<ref name="s">[[Space:A_Brief_Memorial_of_the_Deceased_Members_of_the_Glendinning_Family]]</ref>
